description: Level-3 MOM Workorder (ISA-95 Part 4 / B2MML WorkRequest). Full text: docs/history/standard/profiles/operations/work-order.md, description.

attributes.name: workorder_no
attributes.description: Identity of the Workorder (join key). Recommendation: <production_order_no>.<order_index>.

attributes.name: production_order_ref
attributes.description: FK to ProductionOrder.production_order_no (FOR_OPERATIONS_REQUEST). The FabricationOrder that this sub-lot subdivides.

attributes.name: order_index
attributes.description: The FabricationOrder index (the MES FOIndex) = the slot number of this Workorder.

relationships.description: The ProductionOrder (OperationsRequest) that this Workorder subdivides.
Inverse of MaterialLot.PRODUCED_BY — the material lots created in this slot.

isa95.note: ISA-95 Part 4 WorkRequest = dispatch subdivision of an OperationsRequest. RULE: FabricationOrder index == Workorder (subdivision of the FO across time slots). Creates/consumes MaterialLots. Edge FOR_OPERATIONS_REQUEST to the ProductionOrder (sub-lot / FO index).
